entries.t: 空间电荷区的本征缺陷补偿使无镉锌黄锡矿太阳能电池实现13.9%认证效率
entries.a: RSC - Energy Environ. Sci. latest articles
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能源测/发电技术/光伏
entries.as: 研究采用无镉ZnxSn1-xO（ZTO）缓冲层替代传统CdS，用于Cu2ZnSn(S,Se)4（CZTSSe）黄铜矿太阳能电池。通过在空间电荷区实现本征缺陷补偿，有效抑制了界面复合损失并优化了能带对齐。该策略使无镉kesterite电池获得13.9%的认证效率，创造了该体系无镉缓冲层器件的新纪录，推动了环境友好型薄膜太阳能电池的实用化进程。
kp: 转换效率[CZTSSe薄膜电池]: 13.9%(认证)
缓冲层[无镉电池]: ZnₓSn₁₋ₓO替代CdS
缺陷补偿[空间电荷区]: 本征缺陷补偿
entries.b: Cadmium-free ZnxSn1−xO (ZTO) buffer layers are an attractive alternative to conventional CdS in Cu2ZnSn(S,Se)4 (CZTSSe) thin-film solar cells, especially with advantages of Cd-related toxicity elimination and parasitic absorption mitigation at short wavelengths. However, the performance of ZTO-based CZTSSe devices has lagged behind that of CdS-involved counterparts, largely due to high-density detrimental defects and non-ideal band alignment at the CZTSSe/ZTO heterojunction. Here, we develop a junction heat-treatment process that, upon thermal activation, selectively drives Zn cations to diffuse from the ZTO buffer into the CZTSSe absorber along the chemical potential gradient. This diffusion-driven Zn incorporation compensates for intrinsic bulk defects such as CuZn and VCu, particularly in the space charge region. The cation diffusion also contributes to a more favorable conduction-band offset, prolonged minority-carrier lifetime, and extended carrier-diffusion length. Collectively, this results in optimization of carrier dynamics with simultaneously enhanced carrier separation, extraction, and transport efficiencies. As a result, we achieve an efficiency of 14.39% (certified at 13.90%) and a large-area (1.03 cm2) efficiency of 12.24%, representing the highest-to-date efficiency for Cd-free CZTSSe solar cells.

entries.t: 通过平衡相演化抑制锌黄锡矿太阳能电池缺陷实现15.1%认证效率纪录
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能源测/发电技术/光伏
entries.as: 通过平衡相演化抑制铜锌锡硫硒(CZTSSe)太阳能电池中的缺陷，实现了15.1%的认证效率纪录。该材料使用地壳丰富、无毒元素，兼具低成本与环境友好性，缺陷工程的突破为薄膜太阳能电池效率提升开辟了新路径。
kp: [缺陷抑制]: 反应Na-Sex物种平衡相演化
entries.b: Kesterite (CZTSSe) solar cells use earth-abundant, non-toxic elements but their efficiency is limited by complex defects. We show that an imbalance between intermediate phases during selenization triggers harmful Zn-related defects. Introducing reactive Na-Sex species accelerates Cu2SnSe3 formation and balances phase evolution into CZTSSe, suppressing defect formation. This kinetic control enables a certified 15.1% device performance, clearing a key commercialization benchmark for sustainable thin-film photovoltaics.

entries.t: 调控固体电解质界面实现光电化学N2-to-NH3固定创纪录产率
entries.a: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能量存储/化学能/可再生燃料
entries.as: 该研究通过调控溶剂体系，实现了锂介导的光电化学（PEC）氮气还原制氨，获得了创纪录的产氨速率。锂介导电化学固氮（Li-NRR）是当前少数能实现高选择性N2-to-NH3转化的可行路径之一，但受限于锂表面钝化层和竞争性析氢反应。研究通过优化电解液溶剂化结构，促进了Li3N中间体的生成与质子化，显著提升了法拉第效率和氨产量，为光驱动人工固氮走向实际应用提供了重要突破。
kp: [锂介导光电化学固氮]: 低过电位温和条件产氨
[多功能电解质]: 三氟丙酸乙酯+Na+形成多孔SEI

entries.t: 通过埋底界面异质结工程构建反向电场实现高性能钙钛矿X射线探测器
entries.c: 通用技术/检测和表征/先进科学仪器
entries.as: 该研究通过在钙钛矿X射线探测器中构建埋底界面异质结工程，实现了反向电场设计，有效抑制离子迁移的同时提升器件性能。研究团队采用一维/三维（1D/3D）钙钛矿异质结构，在埋底界面处形成梯度能级排列，产生反向内建电场来阻挡载流子复合和离子漂移。钙钛矿X射线探测器因高吸收系数和直接转换特性在医学成像、安全检测等领域前景广阔，但离子迁移导致的暗电流漂移和信号不稳定是核心瓶颈。该1D/3D界面工程策略显著降低了暗电流并提升了探测灵敏度和响应稳定性，为高性能钙钛矿辐射探测器提供了重要的界面调控思路。

稳定辐射剂量[X射线探测器]: >100 Gyair
[界面工程]: 埋底界面1D/3D钙钛矿异质结
entries.b: A 1D/3D perovskite heterojunction engineered at the buried interface enables effective suppression of ion migration while providing efficient carrier extraction. The resulting X-ray detector achieves a low detection limit of 9.5 nGyairs-1 and stable operation under radiation doses over 100 Gyair, outperforming most reported MAPbI3 thick film X-ray detectors fabricated by slurry blade-coating method.

entries.t: In2O3-CNT催化剂通过空位稳定实现超500小时稳定CO2加氢制甲醇
entries.a: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
entries.as: 氧化铟（In₂O₃）是CO₂加氢制甲醇的有前景催化剂，但面临活性相失活和稳定性不足的难题。本研究将In₂O₃负载于碳纳米管（CNT）上，通过载体-金属强相互作用稳定氧化铟活性相，实现了超过500小时的稳定运行，甲醇选择性显著提升。CNT的导电性和结构特性有效抑制了铟的过度还原和团聚，为CO₂资源化制取绿色甲醇的工业化提供了兼具高活性与长寿命的催化体系设计思路。
kp: 催化剂体系[CO₂加氢]: In₂O₃-CNT物理复合
稳定机制[催化]: 空位稳定化抑制In³⁺过还原

entries.t: 可靠的气相沉积锡基钙钛矿用于高性能低功耗互补电子器件
entries.a: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents

entries.as: 研究者利用气相沉积技术制备锡基（Sn²⁺）钙钛矿薄膜，开发出高性能、低功耗的p型薄膜晶体管。锡钙钛矿作为无铅半导体材料，避免了铅的毒性问题，兼具优异光电性能。气相沉积工艺可实现薄膜均匀性与界面精确控制，推动无铅钙钛矿在互补逻辑电路、柔性电子及低功耗显示驱动等领域的实用化进程，是绿色半导体的前沿方向。

entries.b:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Tin (Sn
                    2+
                    ) perovskites are promising lead‐free semiconductors for high‐performance p‐type thin‐film transistors (TFTs), yet their reproducibility and reliability remain a major obstacle. Subtle variations in precursor chemistry and solvent coordination critically influence colloidal dynamics and crystallization, leading to inconsistent film quality and device performance. Here, we systematically benchmark multiple commercial Sn
                    2+
                    precursors across both solution and vapor deposition routes. While solution‐processed devices exhibit strong precursor dependence, vapor‐deposited films yield consistent TFT performance, achieving hole mobility (∼30 cm
                    2
                     V
                    −1
                     s
                    −1
                    ) and excellent stability regardless of precursor origin. By leveraging thermodynamically driven separation of volatile impurities prior to film nucleation, the vapor‐phase process standardizes crystallization dynamics and enables precursor‐agnostic formation of uniform and dense films with large grains. Built on this robust and scalable platform, integrated p‐type Sn
                    2+
                    ‐perovskite/n‐type oxide circuits deliver high gain and ultra‐low static power consumption at the picowatt level, establishing vapor‐phase deposition as a reliable route for low‐power complementary electronics.
